       (for*/or ((y (range (+ r 1) (+ r size -1))) (x (range (+ c 1) (+ c size -1)))) (= (at g y x) 0))))

       (for*/list ((r (range rlo)) (c (range clo)) (rr (range (+ rhi 1) h)) (cc (range (+ chi 1) w))
